basics.name: Sreehari P V
basics.summary: Software Engineer with 2+ years of experience building scalable web and mobile applications across the React.js, Next.js, and React Native ecosystem. Experienced in developing production-grade applications, enterprise mobile solutions, and AI-driven automation systems. Strong background in TypeScript, modern state management (Redux, React Query, Context API), backend systems using Node.js and NestJS, and performance optimization.

highlights: Implemented a configurable custom theming engine enabling merchants to convert Shopify storefronts into fully functional native mobile applications.
Worked extensively on core React Native modules, gaining deeper understanding of navigation, rendering cycles, and cross-platform performance behavior.
Contributed to development and maintenance of enterprise mobile applications for global brands (NDA projects).
Built secure authentication flows, analytics integrations, push notification systems, and API-driven UI modules.
Optimized performance by reducing re-render cycles, implementing lazy loading, and resolving core bottlenecks.
Worked with GitHub Actions and mobile deployment workflows for CI/CD and release management.
Optimized web application performance using React best practices, lazy loading, and efficient state management.
Led development of a React Native Service Provider Application improving engagement and reliability.
Gained practical understanding of React Native internals while working on shared core modules.
Built a Redis-based caching layer using Sentence Similarity Models, reducing API response time by 40%.
Developed multilingual product classification system using Large Language Models.
Created dynamic SEO optimization module generating meta descriptions and titles from web-scraped data.
Designed real-time reporting system using Apache Superset.
Won 1st place in internal hackathon for AI-powered content refresh system improving SEO by 35%.
